# Workbook mapping

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-workbook-mapping.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

Mapping version: `imprint-xlsx-1`. Decision [0006](decisions/0006-exceljs-for-workbooks.md).

> GENERIC EXPORT — NOT A DTIC SUBMISSION. This workbook is a documented mapping of an OpenSCG guide, produced by Imprint. It has not been checked against any DoD or DTIC template and must not be described as meeting DoDM 5200.45 or any submission format. The OpenSCG JSON file is the authoritative copy; see the loss report for what this workbook does not carry. The digest shown identifies the signed JSON payload; it does not prove this workbook matches it.

Every value is written as a plain text cell, never as a formula or an Excel date. Rows 1 to 3 of every sheet repeat the guide's banner, its status label and its identity (guide ID, revision and payload digest).

## Not carried in the workbook

| JSON pointer | Why |
| --- | --- |
| `/extensions` | Extension data can be any JSON and may be must-understand. It stays in the JSON only; the loss report lists it. |
| `/entries[]/extensions` | Same as guide-level extensions. |
| `/attestations` | Signatures are binary and travel as the detached attestation next to the workbook, not inside it. |
